pipeline_steps.technique: Generation of Unc5b-2A-CreERT2 knock-in mouse line

parameters.targeting: T2A-CreERT2 cassette inserted in-frame immediately before the Unc5b stop codon via PCR-based targeting vector cloning
parameters.es_cells: linearized vectors transfected into a 129SVj/B6 F1 hybrid ES cell line (V6.5), positive clones used to derive heterozygous founders
parameters.cassette_removal: Frt-Neo-Frt cassette removed by breeding with Actin-Flpe transgenic mice

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: Unc5b-2A-CreERT2 knock-in mouse line

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection for cell-type labeling and functional/optogenetic constructs in CA1

parameters.coordinates: dorsal CA1 (2.3 mm posterior, 1.5 mm lateral, 1.45-1.35 mm ventral to bregma) or ventral CA1 (-3.5 mm posterior, 3.4 mm lateral, 3.5 mm ventral)
parameters.viruses: one or more of AAV1.Syn.Flex.GCaMP6f, AAV5-EF1a-DIO-mCherry, AAV5-EF1a-DIO-hChR2(H134R)-mCherry, AAV9-CAG-DIO-ChroME-ST-P2A-H2B-mRuby3, AAV1.Syn.NES-jRGECO1a, AAVDJ-CaMKIIa-GCaMP6f, AAV1.Syn.Flex.NES-jRGECO1a (300-400 nL each, full titer), bilateral for anatomy/physiology or right-hemisphere only for calcium imaging
parameters.optogenetics_cohort: AAV1.Syn.GCaMP6f combined with AAV1-Ef1a-DIO-ChRmine-mScarlet or AAV1-Ef1a-DIO-eNpHR3.0-EYFP via Nanoject syringe, 64 nL per site across 4 dorsoventral depths

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice expressing cell-type-restricted functional indicators and/or optogenetic actuators in CA1

pipeline_steps.technique: Tamoxifen induction of CreER-dependent expression

parameters.dose: 100 mg/kg tamoxifen in corn oil (20 mg/mL), intraperitoneal, under isoflurane anesthesia
parameters.imaging_cohort_schedule: single injection once running performance was sufficient; expression checked 2 days later with a second dose if needed; recordings begun 4 days after the first injection
parameters.other_cohorts_schedule: injected on days 2, 5, and 8 after virus injection

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with induced Cre-dependent expression in Unc5b+ cells

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic hippocampal imaging window surgery

parameters.window: 3.0 mm glass window attached to a 3.0 mm diameter, 1.5 mm height stainless steel cannula with Norland optical adhesive
parameters.procedure: 3.0 mm biopsy-punch craniotomy, dura and cortical layers removed with ice-cold PBS/cortex buffer flushing, cannula secured with Vetbond and UV-curable glue, stainless steel headpost attached with dental cement
parameters.anesthesia_analgesia: isoflurane with meloxicam, or bupivacaine and buprenorphine

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with chronic hippocampal imaging window and headpost

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic silicon-probe implantation for combined two-photon and LFP recording

parameters.probe: single-shank 4-channel linear silicone probe (NeuroNexus) or tungsten bipolar wire electrode (0.5 mm tip separation)
parameters.placement: lowered into dorsal CA1 mirroring the virus injection site during quiet wakefulness on a spherical treadmill, guided by continuous LFP monitoring for SPW-R events, secured at the site of maximal ripple amplitude with UV-curable glue and dental cement

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with chronic silicon probe for correlated 2p imaging and LFP recording
pipeline_steps.hardware: NeuroNexus linear silicone probe; A-M Systems bipolar electrode

pipeline_steps.technique: In vitro whole-cell patch-clamp recording of Unc5b-CreER neurons

parameters.slicing: 300 micron coronal slices in ice-cold NMDG-based protective recovery solution, 12 min recovery incubation at 35°C, then room-temperature aCSF
parameters.visualization: DIC illumination (Olympus BX61WI, Flash4.0 LT+ camera) with mercury-lamp epifluorescence to identify mCherry+ neurons
parameters.recording: Multiclamp 700B amplifier, low-pass filtered at 2 kHz, digitized at 10 kHz (Digidata 1440A); internal solution 126 mM K-gluconate, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM KCl, 4 mM Mg-ATP, 0.3 mM Na-GTP, 10 mM phosphocreatine, 0.2% biocytin
parameters.protocol: firing properties assessed with -100 to 350 pA current-injection steps (1 s), repeated twice per neuron at a resting potential near -65 mV

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: whole-cell current-clamp recordings from identified Unc5b-CreER neurons
pipeline_steps.hardware: Multiclamp 700B amplifier; Digidata 1440A; Olympus BX61WI microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo extracellular recording with optogenetic photoidentification

parameters.probe: 32-channel or 128-channel silicon probe with attached optical fiber lowered into dorsal CA1
parameters.acquisition: 30 kHz continuous acquisition via RHD2132/RHD2164 headstage (Intan Technologies)
parameters.photostimulation: blue laser pulses (430-490 nm, 4.5 mW), 20 ms duration at 2 Hz
parameters.spike_sorting: MountainSort and Kilosort2, followed by manual visual inspection in Phy; units with max spike amplitude <50 microvolts excluded

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: sorted single-unit spike trains with light-evoked response classification
pipeline_steps.hardware: 32/128-channel silicon probe with optical fiber; Intan RHD2132/RHD2164 headstage

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging with correlated locomotion, video, and LFP recording

parameters.scanner: 8 kHz resonant scanner (Neurolabware), 16x 0.8 NA water-immersion objective
parameters.behavior_tracking: quadrature encoder for treadmill movement; eye/whisker video (Allied Vision Mako) captured at frame start/middle
parameters.lfp: single silicon-probe channel amplified (NPI ELC-03XS) and digitized (National Instruments DAC), or bipolar electrodes via a differential amplifier
parameters.sensory_stimuli: visual: moving horizontal line on an LED matrix (8.5 deg/s, 3 s); tactile: motor-mounted whisker probe rotating 360° in 3 s, both triggered by a random process

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: correlated calcium imaging, behavioral video, and LFP recordings
pipeline_steps.hardware: Neurolabware 8 kHz resonant scanner; Allied Vision Mako camera; LED matrix stimulus display

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon calcium imaging with optogenetic manipulation during a spatial navigation task

parameters.scanner: 8 kHz resonant scanner (Bruker), 16x 0.8 NA water-immersion objective (Nikon), 1.5x digital zoom
parameters.excitation: 920 nm (Coherent Ultra II) for imaging; 1030 nm (same laser) or 1070 nm (Coherent Fidelity) for putative axo-axonic cell identification depending on opsin
parameters.behavior: random-foraging training on a clueless burlap belt, then imaging on a 2-m cue-rich belt

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: calcium imaging data with optogenetic AAC manipulation during navigation
pipeline_steps.hardware: Bruker 8 kHz resonant scanner; Coherent Ultra II and Fidelity lasers; Prizmatix LED

pipeline_steps.technique: Transcardial perfusion and tissue fixation

parameters.anesthesia: isoflurane then i.p. ketamine (100 mg/kg)/xylazine (10 mg/kg)
parameters.perfusion: saline or ice-cold PBS followed by 4% PFA (with or without 0.2% picric acid); EM samples additionally fixed with 0.5% glutaraldehyde
parameters.post_fix: 2 h at RT (EM) or 24 h at 4°C (other), sectioned at 60-75 microns on a vibratome

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: fixed, sectioned brain tissue

pipeline_steps.technique: Fluorescent immunostaining and confocal imaging

parameters.primary_antibodies: chicken anti-mCherry, chicken anti-GFP, rabbit anti-phospho-IkBa, guinea pig or chicken anti-parvalbumin, rabbit anti-SATB1
parameters.pv_satb1_double_stain: sequential blocking/permeabilization and 2-day 4°C primary incubation for double PV/SATB1 labeling
parameters.imaging: Zeiss LSM710/LSM800 or Nikon A1 confocal microscope, 10x/0.45NA, 20x/0.8NA, or 63x/1.4NA objectives

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: confocal images of immunolabeled hippocampal sections
pipeline_steps.hardware: Zeiss LSM710/LSM800; Nikon A1 confocal microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: Electron microscopy sample preparation and serial-section synaptic bouton tracing

parameters.preparation: GFP immunostaining with DAB/osmium/uranyl acetate processing, embedded in acetonitrile/EMbed 812
parameters.sectioning: 50 nm ultrathin serial sections on an ultramicrotome (Leica), lead citrate contrast
parameters.imaging: transmission electron microscope (JEM-1400, JEOL) with a OneView (Gatan) camera, 5000-20000x magnification
parameters.analysis: immunopositive boutons identified by synaptic vesicles, followed through serial sections to identify somatic/dendritic/AIS postsynaptic targets by ultrastructural criteria

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: serially traced synaptic boutons with identified postsynaptic target compartments
pipeline_steps.hardware: JEM-1400 transmission electron microscope; Gatan OneView camera; Leica ultramicrotome

pipeline_steps.technique: Confocal image analysis: laminar cell-body distribution and AAC-AIS 3D distance quantification

parameters.laminar_distribution: cell-body positions marked on maximum-intensity projections relative to manually drawn layer borders, fluorescence intensity normalized to the maximum observed across animals
parameters.3d_distance: OTSU thresholding (mCherry channel) and local Moran's I spatial clustering (p-IkBa channel) to identify positive voxels, converted to point clouds and compared via kd-tree nearest-neighbor distance (3 micron threshold)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: laminar cell distribution and 3D AAC-process-to-AIS distances

pipeline_steps.technique: Quantification of Unc5b-AAC-innervated AIS ratio

parameters.method: AISs labeled blind to reporter channel via freehand lines, converted to 5-micron-thick measurement areas; fluorescence intensity and thresholded (Huang method) positive-pixel counts measured pre/post 90° rotation for normalization
parameters.classification: AIS reporter intensity normalized to the average across all AIS objects in the image; normalized values >1 (with PV-pixel ratio threshold 0.2) classified as axo-axonic-innervated

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: thin z-stacks of AAC reporter and PV/p-IkBa immunostaining
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified AAC-innervated vs. non-innervated AISs

pipeline_steps.technique: In vitro electrophysiology intrinsic-property analysis and PCA-based classification

parameters.metrics: input resistance, sag, AP threshold (dV/dt exceeding 3 SD), AP width, afterhyperpolarization, rheobase, upstroke/downstroke velocity, adaptation score, burstiness score, fast/medium AHP
parameters.exclusion: neurons with resting potential above -55 mV or input resistance >500 MOhm excluded
parameters.pca: principal component analysis performed across the full set of extracted intrinsic-property features

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: intrinsic electrophysiological feature set and PCA-based cell characterization

pipeline_steps.technique: Spike-waveform-based cell-type classification and optical photoidentification

parameters.classification: 2D Gaussian mixture model fit to spike width and valley-to-peak time to classify putative pyramidal neurons (n=495) vs. interneurons (n=128); ambiguous units (n=82) excluded
parameters.photoidentification: parameter-free ZETA test (Montijn et al., 2020) on event-aligned spike-time cumulative distributions; peak/trough response latency 1-50 ms required for significance (p<0.01)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified cell types and optically identified putative axo-axonic cells

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium movie preprocessing, ROI segmentation, and cross-session tracking for combined imaging/LFP experiments

parameters.segmentation: Unc5b-AAC ROIs segmented via SIMA's STICA method or manually; other neurons segmented via SIMA's PlaneCA1PC method
parameters.tracking: AACs matched and assigned unique IDs across multiple imaging sessions of the same FOV; unitary response properties computed from all events across sessions

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, segmented, cross-session-tracked ΔF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Event-triggered average response analysis (whisking, sharp-wave ripples, running)

parameters.whisking_detection: motion-energy map from video, z-scored, positive frames (z>1) clustered via DBSCAN (eps=1s) to define whisking event onsets
parameters.spwr_detection: automatic LFP-based SPW-R detection with manual curation, blind to calcium responses; response quantified from max dF/dt in a 0-100 ms window post-ripple onset vs. 1,000 matched random control events
parameters.averaging_rule: non-overlapping event windows (400 ms minimum gap) averaged first per-ROI then per-cell-type; automated to remove investigator bias

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: ΔF/F traces, LFP traces, and behavioral video
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: event-triggered average calcium responses to whisking, SPW-Rs, and running onset

pipeline_steps.technique: Unit-unit and population-population correlation analysis

parameters.unit_unit: Pearson correlation between full ΔF/F traces; time-resolved via rolling ±1 s windows
parameters.population_population: z-scored ΔF/F averaged by cell type, resampled into variable-size bins (0.1-10 s) with a temporal shift (-10 to 10 s) applied before binning; correlation computed per bin size/offset after sorting

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: unit-unit and AAC-vs-Other population correlation metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium movie preprocessing and ROI segmentation for optogenetics experiments

parameters.segmentation: Suite2p spatial-mask ROI detection with cross-ROI/neuropil contamination correction, curated post hoc in the Suite2p GUI to exclude non-somatic components

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, segmented ΔF/F traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Stimulation responsiveness and calcium-event quantification

parameters.responsiveness_metric: difference between the activity metric inside the stimulus window and an identical-width pre-stimulus window
parameters.model: linear mixed-effects model (Transients ~ Stim + (1|Animal)) compared to a null model via ANOVA

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: ΔF/F traces around optogenetic stimulus onsets
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-cell stimulation responsiveness and transient-rate change significance

pipeline_steps.technique: Identification of spatially tuned cells and place-field detection

parameters.tuning_curve: 2-m belt divided into 100 bins, mean ΔF/F per bin per lap during running epochs, Gaussian-smoothed (sigma=3 bins) and averaged across laps
parameters.null_model: 100 shuffles of lap-by-lap tuning curves; bins exceeding the 99th percentile of the shuffle distribution classified as place fields
parameters.consistency_filter: place fields required in the same location on at least 3 laps

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected place fields

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-field remapping and turnover analysis in response to AAC manipulation

parameters.pv_correlation: population vector correlation computed for every pair of spatial bins across PRE/STIM/POST lap blocks
parameters.remapping_quantification: average Pearson correlation of PRE population vectors with POST counterparts, compared against unstimulated control sessions
parameters.turnover_analysis: 2x2 contingency tables of place-field presence in PRE vs. POST for the stimulation-zone quintile, tested with the McNemar-Bowker test

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: detected place fields across PRE/STIM/POST lap blocks
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: remapping magnitude and place-field turnover significance

pipeline_steps.technique: General statistical and modeling framework

parameters.test_selection: appropriate tests selected per study design, assumptions checked via Q-Q or residual plots
parameters.reporting: mean ± SEM unless otherwise specified, two-sided tests unless noted
parameters.mixed_models: linear mixed-effects models (e.g. Response ~ CellType + Sex + (1|Animal)) compared to null models via ANOVA

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection of ChR-eYFP or eYFP-only control into bilateral dorsal CA1, followed by metal headbar implantation
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: opsin/reporter-expressing CA1 neurons, head-fixable mouse
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Sncg-Flp mice were injected with a virus expressing either ChR-eYFP or eYFP

pipeline_steps.technique: Craniotomy and chronic silicon-probe (with attached optical fiber) lowering into dorsal CA1 for in vivo extracellular recording

parameters.timing: at least 3 weeks post virus injection

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: positioned silicon probe in dorsal CA1
pipeline_steps.hardware: Buzsaki32/Poly10mm silicon probe with optical fiber
pipeline_steps.source_quote: silicon probe with an attached optical fiber was gradually lowered

pipeline_steps.technique: Continuous 30-kHz extracellular recording with optogenetic light-pulse identification of light-responsive single units

parameters.light_pulses: 20-ms blue laser pulses (430-490 nm, 4.5 mW) at 2 Hz

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw extracellular voltage traces
pipeline_steps.source_quote: OpenEphys recording system was used together with Intan 32 channel headstages

pipeline_steps.technique: Offline spike sorting and visual-inspection curation of single units
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: sorted single-unit spike trains
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Offline spike sorting was performed using MountainSort

pipeline_steps.technique: Light-triggered average firing-rate analysis with z-score normalization to estimate light-driven suppression
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: normalized light-triggered average firing rates
pipeline_steps.source_quote: average firing rates for each unit were then normalized with z-scoring
